title: Validate public storefront login, cart flow, and product image consistency
body:
Target application: https://www.saucedemo.com/

Acceptance criteria:
1. A user with valid credentials can sign in and reach the inventory page.
2. Invalid credentials are rejected and an explanatory error message is shown.
3. A user can add the selected product to the shopping cart.
4. The shopping cart displays the selected product.
5. The product listing must display distinct product images for distinct products. A repeated image used for multiple different product names is a defect and must be reported as a failed scenario.

Test data for this public demo application:
- Valid username: standard_user
- Valid password: secret_sauce
- Invalid username: invalid_user
- Invalid password: invalid_pass
- Product to add and verify: Sauce Labs Backpack
- Known defect-reproduction account: problem_user
- Known defect-reproduction password: secret_sauce

Planning requirements:
- Each scenario runs in a fresh browser session and must include its own login/setup steps.
- For add-to-cart, target the Add to cart control associated with Sauce Labs Backpack.
- For cart contents, log in, add Sauce Labs Backpack, then open the cart and verify the product name.
- For the defect scenario, log in as problem_user, inspect the product listing, and verify whether distinct products have distinct image sources. Do not mark it failed unless the observed images actually violate the criterion.
- Never treat API, browser, locator, or network errors as application defects.
